title: Rust TDMA/CCP FSM gaps vs spec 09 14.7-14.8: RECOVERING timeout, sfn_delta, pre-TX gate
description: Spec 09 14.7/14.8 rows R-09-141/149/152. Rust gaps: (1) DesyncFSM (rust/lichen-core/src/desync.rs:42-152) has no on_missed_superframe/RECOVERING 3-superframe timeout - Python (timing/sfn.py:77-133) and C (tdma.c:102-162, link.h LICHEN_DESYNC_RECOVERY_BEACONS 3u) both implement it; (2) no production sfn_delta with unsigned 32-bit modulo semantics (only test-local wrapping_sub oracle at rust/lichen-node/tests/sfn_wrap_vectors.rs:56-60; canonical vectors ccp_sfn_wrap_slot_hash.json); (3) no combined pre-assigned-slot-TX gate for authenticated link identity + replay state + initialized RPL/DODAG context + time/SFN state - C enforces the full chain in lichen_link_tx.c:63-106 (-ENOKEY/-EBUSY/latch), Rust tdma_scheduler.rs is slot-math only. Note (not a bead item): CcpState enum names Unjoined/Joined/Drift/Recover differ from spec ACQUIRING/SYNCED/DRIFTING/REJOINING; spec 14.8 says platform names are implementation details, verify behavior mapping only. Vectors: ccp_sfn_wrap_slot_hash.json, ccp16-desync.json, tdma_ccp_fsm.json.
